title: Install archlinuxcn keyring for Chinese community repo
summary: The archlinuxcn repository requires its specific keyring package to be installed first to verify package signatures. Without it, pacman will fail with signature errors.
prerequisites: The 'archlinuxcn' repository is already added to /etc/pacman.conf

steps.explain: Install the archlinuxcn-keyring package. This package is signed by an official developer, so it can be installed even if the repository keys are not yet trusted.

warnings: Ensure the repository is added to pacman.conf before attempting this installation.
